title: The Playground
text:
Ali likes the playground. It is next to his school. In summer, the children play on the slide and the swings. The sun is hot, so they drink water.

In winter, the playground is cold. There is snow on the grass. The children wear hats and gloves. They build a snowman and laugh a lot.

questions.text: What do the children wear in winter?
How do the children probably feel on the snowy day?
Why does the passage describe both summer and winter?
options: To show how the playground changes with the seasons
To explain how to build a snowman
To tell a story about Ali's family

vocabulary.definition: an outdoor area where children play
a long smooth structure that children go down for fun
seats hung from a frame that children move back and forth
a figure made of packed snow

paragraph_translations: Ali oyun alanını sever. Okulunun yanındadır. Yazın çocuklar kaydırakta ve salıncaklarda oynar. Güneş sıcaktır, bu yüzden su içerler.
Kışın oyun alanı soğuktur. Çimlerin üzerinde kar vardır. Çocuklar şapka ve eldiven takar. Bir kardan adam yaparlar ve çok gülerler.
